summary: Retry still impossible after an interrupted install on Linux/macOS - the workspace half of MPI-408. engine.js:344 only clears a workspace with NO .git, but the clone finishes in seconds while deps take minutes, so an interrupted setup leaves a COMPLETE clone that comfy install refuses (exit 1, names --restore). Fixed by pushing --restore when the workspace is already a clone. Found while verifying MPI-408, which is itself confirmed fixed.
